entities.name: Plane
entities.description: A self-contained reality, world, or universe of any size within the Multiverse, whose character is partly defined by the behavior of its mana.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The whole of reality containing almost infinite planes.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space separating planes, filled with chaotic energies including aether and mana.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: The aware essence of a plane, with which some magic such as Nissa Revane's may communicate.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between planes left behind by the New Phyrexian Invasion, letting non-planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: A planar portal device developed from Rashmi's Matter Transporter by Tezzeret; it cannot safely transport organic matter.

entities.name: Matter Transporter
entities.description: Rashmi's aether device that Saheeli realized might reach into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: A cosmic tree grown by Elesh Norn that forms Omenpaths between planes for New Phyrexia's invasion.

entities.name: Filigree Sylex
entities.description: A device detonated in the Blind Eternities that scarred the multiverse.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact Bolas stole using the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: The event that closed planar portals and weakened planeswalkers' ability to bring others along.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of many planes by New Phyrexia through Omenpaths.

entities.name: First Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The 4205 AR invasion of Dominaria that included the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The transplanting of the artificial plane of Rath on top of Dominaria.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica with his Eternals, exposing Ravnica to the wider multiverse.

entities.name: The Desparking
entities.description: The event that caused many planeswalkers to lose their sparks.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Once thought the prime reality; has a long history with planeswalkers and interplanar affairs.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane exposed to the multiverse in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: A plane formed by a collision of two planes, home of Strixhaven and the Biblioplex.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane where Rashmi built the Matter Transporter.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A large plane containing the Ten Realms, which collide in a doomskar.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane as small as a continent.

entities.name: Equilor
entities.description: An ancient plane with a magically advanced civilization that has insight on other planes.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A plane where visitors are shifted into native creature forms.

entities.name: Segovia
entities.description: A plane where visiting planeswalkers are shrunk to scale.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane formerly Argentum and Mirrodin, launching the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An inventor and planeswalker who helped Rashmi complete the Matter Transporter.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An elven aether-seer and inventor on Avishkar who built the Matter Transporter.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who had Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who used the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and move his Eternals.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian Praetor who grew Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian sent to Kaldheim to retrieve tyrite.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker made Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug, later turned into an otterfolk on Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon who leads the Izzet and learns of other planes.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: An elder demon who creates doors to other planes to lure victims into Duskmourn.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought Xantcha with him and sought information from Equilor.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who remained in his Lorwyn form after sparking and leaving the daylit side.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker who did not return to human form in the morning on another plane.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A stitcher who theorized that magic users acclimatize to a new plane's rules.

events.summary: Dominaria faces the First Phyrexian Invasion, including the Rathi Overlay, which broadens Dominarians' understanding of other planes.
events.quote: In 4205 A.R., Dominaria faced the First Phyrexian Invasion , including the Rathi Overlay where the artificial plane of Rath was transplanted on top of Dominaria.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet appoints Ral Zarek Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug, intended to track Jace.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet appointed Ral Zarek as the Head Researcher for Project Lightning Bug

events.summary: Ravnica is exposed to the wider multiverse when Bolas's Eternals invade.
events.quote: Ravnica is later exposed to the wider multiverse during the War of the Spark , when Bolas 's Eternals invaded the plane.

events.summary: After the battle, Niv-Mizzet tasks Ral, Vraska and Kaya with hunting Tezzeret, Dovin Baan and Liliana Vess.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet consulted with representatives of every guild and tasked Ral Zarek, Vraska , and Kaya to hunt down Tezzeret , Dovin Baan , and Liliana Vess , respectively

events.summary: The Great Mending closes planar portals and weakens planeswalkers' ability to bring others and summon creatures.
events.quote: The Great Mending closed existing planar portals, weakened planeswalkers' ability to bring others with them while planeswalking, and the ability to summon creatures from other planes.

events.summary: On Avishkar, Rashmi works on the Matter Transporter, and Saheeli eventually relents and helps complete it.
events.quote: However, Saheeli eventually relented and helped Rashmi complete the device.

events.summary: The Consulate seizes Rashmi and her invention at the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: both inventor and invention were seized by the Consulate during their confiscation of submitted inventions

events.summary: Tezzeret has Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: Tezzeret had Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge

events.summary: Bolas uses the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and to transport his Eternals.
events.quote: Bolas would later use the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and later to transport his army of Eternals during the War of the Spark.

events.summary: Elesh Norn sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim for a sample of tyrite.
events.quote: Elesh Norn sent Vorinclex to the plane of Keldheim to retrieve a sample of tyrite

events.summary: The multiverse is scarred by the Invasion and the Desparking, leaving Omenpaths between planes.
events.quote: Along with the Desparking, causing many of the multiverse's planeswalkers to lose their sparks, the Invasion left behind Omenpaths between planes.

events.summary: Ral Zarek is turned into an otterfolk upon planeswalking to Bloomburrow.
events.quote: Ral Zarek was turned into an otterfolk when he planeswalked to Bloomburrow.
